🧱 CMU Common Wall
Remove the non-retaining CMU wall between 141 and 135 N Anita. Pricing assumes it is NOT retaining — confirm grades match on both sides before removal. Put temporary fencing on the property line the same day the wall comes down so 135 N Anita is never left open.
🌿 South Landscape Strip
Clear the planting along the south side CMU wall. Load, haul and recycle the green waste and keep the disposal records. Work carefully next to 135 N Anita: no root pulling or trenching that could undermine the neighbor's side.
🚗 Driveway + Walks
Remove the driveway and front walk. Protect the sidewalk, curb and street during removal, and photograph their condition before and after. Any curb cut or driveway approach work in the public right-of-way needs its own City permit, which is not part of this proposal.
🪨 Patios + Slabs
Remove the rear patios, the house and garage slabs, and the conventional foundations and footings. Any unusual foundations found are excluded and handled by change order. Backfill all demolition excavations.
💧 Irrigation + Site Utilities
Remove the irrigation. Locate utilities and call DigAlert 811 before any digging. Water disposition and the sewer locate/cap are coordinated with the utility disconnect scope.
📐 Rough Grade + Drainage
Backfill and rough-grade the cleared site so it drains safely until the new build starts. Final condition is ready for the Phase 2 handoff. Extra soil hauling is $1,500 per load and is not included in the base price.
